scope: Observations extracted from the initial failed Playwright run; original trace archives were auto-cleaned by the subsequent run, so these are diagnostic notes rather than retained raw traces.

firefoxGuideAnchor.observation: API browser heading existed and hash matched, but stylesheet completion followed the anchor action; layout then moved the heading outside the viewport.
firefoxGuideAnchor.fix: Wait for load and observed header CSS before subsequent navigation or anchor actions; retain viewport assertion and deliberately delay CSS 400 ms in regression.

webkitInitialLoads.test: SDK landing exposes actionable documentation and fits compact and desktop screens
responds to DOM tampering with a real modal and provides a demo exit

webkitEvidenceBoundary: An unfinished trace request is not proof no response bytes arrived, and does not establish an HTTP/2 or preload-coalescing defect. Same-code serial 2 and parallel repeated 10 checks passed without timeout changes or SRI/preload removal. No root-cause fix is claimed.
